name: All-Beef Regular Hot Dog on Soft Warm Bun (Plain)
whyItWorks: An uncured or regular steamed all-beef frankfurter served plain on a soft white baker's bun is naturally dairy-free and fiber-free, offering easy-to-chew protein and simple starch on the go.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the hot dog plain without relish, sauerkraut, onions, or spicy mustard. Ketchup or light yellow mustard is usually tolerated.
